title: Java/Swing/JMS lessons learned in the ooRexx API projects

records.rule: Java language support is first-class in LLM Gopher v0.17-dev1 through a language-module descriptor, source.java.examine, source.symbol.lookup and source.java.compile.
Prefer src/ source roots; Java projects commonly use src/main/java and src/test/java. Exact source member and exact declaration lookup precede text fallback.
FederationBank Java ATM compiles main/test sources with javac --release 17 -Xlint:all and runs tests with java -ea.
Swing widget access belongs on the EDT; WireSwingEdt marshals with invokeAndWait and restores interrupt status on InterruptedException.
Swing listeners capture local value state and enqueue UI_ACTION; they do not call application logic, ooRexx, Queue Fabric, JMS/network code, or wait for a server response.
Preflight semantic patch validity before EDT commit so a later invalid operation cannot leave a half-mutated UI.
Stamp viewRef/revision when the Swing action is queued, not later when transport drains it.
Relayout existing JComponent instances rather than reconstructing unrelated siblings when the semantic protocol did not replace them.
Set JMSCorrelationID=commandId and JMSReplyTo; use a selector/correlation check and a bounded receive timeout.
A retransmission of one business action retains the same commandId and idempotencyKey.
Own and close consumer, producer, session, connection and naming context at the transport boundary even on failure.
The Java ATM reads a JMS password from a configured environment-variable name; missing required configuration fails explicitly.
A successful JMS exchange is transport evidence; it does not transfer bank/business authority into the ATM or bridge.
A Java conditional expression once promoted integer JSON tokens to Double, changing signed canonical JSON from 50000 to 50000.0; use explicit numeric branches where representation matters.
Java Instant nanosecond output exceeded the ooRexx DateTime parser contract; ATM requests cap UTC timestamp output at millisecond precision.
The real Java→ActiveMQ→ooRexx→bank→JMS round trip found defects that local unit-shaped reasoning did not.
